gbt7714_numeric.label: GB/T 7714—2015 Sequential Numeric (顺序编码制)
rules: Western author names formatted as SURNAME Initials (e.g., SMITH J A).
Up to 3 authors listed; >3 authors truncated after 3rd with ', 等' (ZH) or ', et al' (EN).
Document type indicator [J]/[C]/[M]/[D]/[R]/[EB/OL] appended immediately after title.
Proceedings entries include '//Proceedings Title' before place/year/pages.
Include DOI at end when available without inventing missing DOIs.

gbt7714_author_year.label: GB/T 7714—2015 Author-Year (著者—出版年制)
rules: In-text label uses (FirstAuthor, Year) or (Author1, Author2, Year) for 2 authors, and (FirstAuthor 等, Year) / (FirstAuthor et al., Year) for 3+.
Bibliography sorted alphabetically by first author surname (or pinyin/stroke), then year with a/b disambiguation.

apa7.label: APA 7th Edition
rules: In-text: 1 author (Smith, 2021); 2 authors (Smith & Lee, 2021); 3+ authors (Smith et al., 2021).
Same first author and year disambiguated deterministically as 2021a, 2021b in bibliography order.
Reference list lists up to 20 authors (Surname, F. M.), separated by '&' before the final author.
Append https://doi.org/<doi> when DOI is present.

ieee.label: IEEE Reference Style
rules: Authors formatted as 'F. M. Surname'; >6 authors truncated to first author + 'et al.'.
Article title enclosed in quotation marks with trailing comma inside quotes.
Format: Authors, "Title," Journal, vol. X, no. Y, pp. Z–W, Year, doi: ... .

nature.label: Nature Portfolio Numeric Style
rules: Numeric sequential markers; up to 5 authors listed before 'et al.'.
Format: Surname, F. M. et al. Title. *Journal* **vol**, pages (Year).

vancouver.label: Vancouver / ICMJE Numeric Style
rules: Authors as 'Surname FM'; up to 6 authors + 'et al'.
Format: Authors. Title. Journal. Year;Vol(Issue):Pages. doi:...

chicago_author_year.label: Chicago Manual of Style (Author-Date)
rules: In-text: (Smith 2021), (Smith and Lee 2021), or (Smith et al. 2021) for 4+ authors.
Reference list: First author 'Surname, First', subsequent 'First Surname'.
